notes:
- Two tabs replace the sidebar: Clean up gives the answer, Explore shows the disk.
- One cleanup on every screen: the pill in the header opens it, docked beside you, with Review and clean always in view.
- What rebuilds itself is in the cleanup after a scan; nothing moves until the final check.
- Worth a look: idle project dependencies, local AI models, finished worktrees, old installers, device backups, big files not opened in a year, duplicates and old AI sessions, each with its own Add.
- See everything found: every category DiskAtlas recognises, each item with its own tick.
- Explore in columns, folder by folder, or as a map coloured by what things are.
- Old Claude Code and Codex sessions by project, with a preview of each.
- A folder you tick goes in whole; when something cannot go, it says why.
- Never suggest this: hide a folder from Clean up for good, and undo it in Settings.
- The final check groups everything by what happens to it; Keep takes an item out.
- Done shows free space now and after the Trash is emptied, and puts everything back in one click.
- Library Caches and Logs are emptied rather than moved, which macOS refused before.
- Pause a scan and carry on later.
- Offline mode asks one simple question when it goes on.
